optimizer.deployment: Enumerate ALL 432 zero-or-measured-count Cartesian states; budget/coverage reject only; capacity feasibility LP for continuous routes
optimizer.routing: All admitted tasks free. With this pool only Text/Image/LID have G/S choice. Continuous differential evolution with two fixed seeds, corner enumeration and Powell polishing; no preferred split. No global continuous-optimality certificate claimed.
optimizer.queue_model: Independent Poisson thinning per worker, deterministic path service=s0*n/g(n), exact M/G/1 mean; stationary waiting CDF via Pollaczek-Khinchine compound geometric equilibrium-residual distribution FFT. Tail is model-derived, not real GPU evidence.
optimizer.mean_window_throughput_loss: Stationary latency CDF integrated over 120s scheduled cohort; fixed offered QPS denominator. Stable nominal demand<1 only.
optimizer.capacity_model_scope: Standalone g does not certify Poisson co-location stability. Module17 envelope not transferred.

Stage_A_gate: Unconstrained winners LOW have no MMS and LID G-only; MID deploy MMS; HIGH has 0<G LID share<1. Each matched nominal-feasible control must have predicted delta_U>0.01 after finer CDF refinement; numerical resolutions must retain signs. Otherwise stop before any GPU.

GPU_protocol.arrival_trajectory: pre-generated per-task exponential interarrivals; paired configs share full task/sample/relative arrival trajectory, routing uniforms and replica uniforms; no seed selection
GPU_protocol.stop: After each stage evaluate all three scheduled pairs. Hard worker/system instability twice in either arm stops remaining formal stages; fatal runtime/memory/release error stops immediately. Any stage without three finite paired utility gains >0.01, all same direction and nominal paired 95% t CI lower>0, stops subsequent formal stages. No retry or input change.
GPU_protocol.benefit_rule: All 3 delta_U>0.01; mean>0.01; all same direction; paired df=2 nominal 95% t CI excludes zero. CI exploratory, not multiplicity-corrected. Unstable control U=null: capacity feasibility evidence separate, never utility win.
